question: Can source-bounded tasks from two held-out families be expressed without feeding their finished design or hindsight rationale to a builder?
selection_basis: Different project/architect identities from the current three pilot sources; selected from existing corpus metadata, before new primary reading or model outputs. No selection on model performance.

excluded_candidate.name: Mieszkanie Piotra
excluded_candidate.reason: Same Mili Młodzi Ludzie designers as the newly admitted Dlugi training-source knowledge; avoid this author overlap in the initial independent-source batch.

admission_requirements: Attributable project identity and resident/activity conditions
Separate source facts from researcher reconstruction assumptions
No finished layout, reference coordinates, professional hindsight or target action in builder input
Every requested function retained even if engine cannot yet validate it
Do not call this a sealed test until task/evaluator/method budgets and exposure have been reviewed
